notes: The second «ح»-route writes «حدثنا شعبة» again, so both routes meet at Shu'ba and the names written once after that (Amr, Ibn Abi Layla, Zayd) form the shared tail (rule 3)
«قلنا لزيد بن أرقم» : Zayd is the one asked and answers, a link in his own place (rule 5); the asker «قلنا» is the speakers, not a name
«كبرنا ونسينا» is Zayd's own words, so he is the last link (rule 6)
